title: Reading a recorded state
statement: For types $Q$ and $T$, define a partial state-reading function from record symbols of types $Q$ and $T$ to an optional optional state: on a state-cell symbol carrying $q$, it returns $q$ as a present result; on every other record symbol, it returns no result. The supplied optional optional state parameter does not affect the output.
